school-erp.title: School Management System
school-erp.stack: Next.js · React · MongoDB Atlas · Cloudinary · Tailwind CSS
school-erp.description: A school ERP in development for Shree Sardar Patel Vidhya Sankool, Navsari. The platform brings academic and administrative workflows into role-based student, faculty, and administrator interfaces. My work focuses on backend logic, database relationships, permissions, authentication, and feature integration.
features: Role-based workflows cover attendance, homework, materials, fees, notices, and academic records.
MongoDB Atlas stores application data; Cloudinary supports uploaded media.
In development. Future database migrations and VPS deployment are exploration, not completed features.

manoviz.title: ManoViz
manoviz.stack: ESP32 · Arduino C++ · FastLED · WS2812B LEDs
manoviz.description: A physical teaching model that makes Morris Mano’s Basic Computer visible through LEDs. Register activations, bus transfers, and instruction-cycle timing translate abstract micro-operations into tangible sequences. My contribution spans hardware planning, LED mapping, firmware, and debugging.
features: Fetch, decode, and execution timing across T0–T6.
Register and bus visualizations for memory-reference and register-reference instructions.
Working prototype across several hardware iterations; the final LED count is not fixed.

codeoracle.title: CodeOracle
codeoracle.stack: Python · JavaScript · LLM APIs · Source analysis
codeoracle.description: An AI-assisted developer tool for understanding projects, exploring dependencies, generating tests, and suggesting refactors. The hackathon work combined source inspection with LLM requests and efficiency improvements.
features: Explanation, dependency graph, tests, and refactored-code workflows.
Reported development test coverage ranged from 86.7% to 100%; one request-path comparison improved from about 43s to 1.76s.
These are observed development measurements, not general benchmarks or production guarantees.

interviewspar.title: InterviewSpar
interviewspar.tagline: Practice the conversation before it counts.
interviewspar.stack: Full-stack web · MongoDB Atlas · AI APIs
interviewspar.description: A collaborative interview-preparation application exploring personalized practice, coding rounds, resume intelligence, and feedback. My role includes frontend experience, integration planning, architecture coordination, and technical presentation.
features: Split-screen interview and coding-round interface work.
Resume intelligence connected to MongoDB Atlas; feedback and reporting screens were designed.
Includes team-developed modules and designed workflows; a unified production deployment is not verified.

prezon.title: Prezon
prezon.tagline: Attendance that travels with the teacher.
prezon.stack: ESP32-S3 · Fingerprint sensors · Wi-Fi · REST APIs
prezon.description: A portable fingerprint-attendance device concept for classrooms. The design explores faculty authentication, class-session logic, student scans, and offline records. My contribution includes product ideation, sensor testing, firmware exploration, and hardware trade-offs.
features: Planned offline caching and synchronization when connectivity returns.
Sensor exploration included R307S testing and ESP32 serial interfacing.
Hardware prototyping and design work; a fully assembled deployable handheld unit is not confirmed.

anpr.title: ANPR Traffic Analytics
anpr.tagline: From road imagery to structured records.
anpr.description: A computer-vision exploration of vehicle imagery and automatic number plate recognition, with traffic analytics as the broader direction. My work involved Python experimentation and recognition-workflow exploration.
features: Intended pipeline: vehicle image, plate localization, character recognition, structured records.
Explored practical constraints including lighting, orientation, occlusion, and image quality.
Partially implemented. No final OCR pipeline, dataset accuracy, or deployment is verified.

light-robot.title: Light-Following Robot
light-robot.tagline: A little machine, led by light.
light-robot.stack: Arduino Uno · Embedded C/C++ · Light sensors · Motor control
light-robot.description: An autonomous Arduino vehicle that follows a light source and demonstrates self-parking. Developed over approximately four months through sensor calibration, motor-control logic, hardware integration, and practical testing.
features: Converts light-sensor readings into movement decisions.
Integrates controller code, drive motors, electrical connections, and chassis behavior.
Completed and tested, with documented light-following and self-parking behavior.

qr-attendance.title: QR Attendance
qr-attendance.tagline: A lighter way to check in.
qr-attendance.stack: QR identification · Attendance records · Web concept
qr-attendance.description: A concept for digital attendance using QR identification to connect a participant with an attendance session. The documented scope is the high-level purpose, rather than a verified finished implementation.
features: Proposed QR validation and user/session association.
Potential settings include classrooms, workshops, and campus events.
Screens, security behavior, database design, and implementation stack remain unverified.

silentguardian.title: SilentGuardian
silentguardian.tagline: An idea awaiting its first prototype.
silentguardian.description: An early safety-oriented technology idea. This entry records the planning direction without presenting an undocumented concept as a finished product.
features: Safety-oriented direction identified during planning.
Next steps: define specific users, the problem, and a measurable prototype.
No finalized feature set, technical architecture, or tested implementation is documented.

smoker-prediction.title: Smoker Status Prediction
smoker-prediction.tagline: A classification workflow, from the data up.
smoker-prediction.stack: Python · Pandas · NumPy · scikit-learn · Logistic Regression
smoker-prediction.description: An academic binary-classification exercise using structured data and Logistic Regression. My contribution includes dataset inspection, preprocessing decisions, initial model design, and evaluation planning.
features: Training schema: 15,000 records × 24 columns; test schema: 10,000 × 23.
Studied missing values, identifiers, outliers, feature preparation, and baseline training.
No verified final accuracy, recall, precision, ROC-AUC, or submission score is claimed.

brainy-beam.title: Brainy Beam ML Internship
brainy-beam.description: Dataset-based machine-learning work during a one-month Brainy Beam internship. This is an experience record covering practical Python and ML workflows, rather than a separately named deployed application.
features: Data cleaning, exploration, and feature handling.
Model-training practice, evaluation, and iteration.
Individual model titles, datasets, and verified performance statistics are not documented.
